summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a Go binary with a WebSocket-driven remote PTY and Anthropic-key harvester
details: The package ships a single darwin/amd64 Go binary as its only content. The binary imports github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket and hardcodes wss://relay.sextant.top plus https://relay.sextant.top/install, connecting outbound to that relay and piping received bytes into a PTY on the local host — a network-driven interactive shell reachable by whoever controls the relay. The same binary embeds an Anthropic API key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}), reads CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and Claude Code settings.local paths, and calls https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models — the standard shape for locating and validating the installer's Anthropic credentials. It additionally queries http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,isp,org,as,proxy,hosting,mobile,query to fingerprint the installer's public IP, ISP, ASN, and hosting/proxy/mobile flags for the relay. The package.json license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, whose repository name aligns with the binary's behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
